rev_init_1.review: The real-time keyboard latency is unbelievable! Solo Practice helped me break 115 WPM in just 2 days. Best typing battle arena on the web.

rev_init_2.review: Ranked duels get intense! Love the live racer tracks and audio effects. The new winning streak tracker makes every match count.

rev_init_3.review: Super clean design and love that guests can practice without login. Beautiful UI and smooth animations!
